name: bootstrap
description: Bootstraps a new machine to this versioned Claude Code setup. Two layers: (1) auto-syncs third-party marketplaces & plugins via hooks (manifest-driven convergence), and (2) applies the versioned global config — env vars, permissions, behavior flags, the global CLAUDE.md, and a machine-resolved statusLine. Replaces bootstrap-third-party. Run /bootstrap:setup once per new machine. Ships the 'Clean Style' output style (single prose ceiling, pasted evidence exempt) and a report-only conformance checker that diffs the live machine against the versioned contract.
